correctness.description: Test `test_plane_issue_created_from_email` passes: Test that a Plane issue was created from the email.
Test `test_issue_title_matches_email_subject` passes: Test that the issue title matches the email subject.
Test `test_issue_description_matches_email_body` passes: Test that the issue description contains the email body.
Test `test_issue_has_medium_priority` passes: Test that the issue has medium priority.

functional.description: The solution uses the MailHog HTTP API at 'http://mailhog:8025/api/v2/messages' to fetch emails
functional.rationale: MailHog provides HTTP API for retrieving captured emails

functional.description: The solution fetches emails from MailHog without authentication (MailHog requires no authentication)
functional.rationale: MailHog does not require authentication for API access

functional.description: The solution uses the correct API operations for MailHog
functional.rationale: Using correct API operations ensures task completion

robustness.description: The solution verifies that at least one email exists in MailHog before attempting to extract email data
robustness.rationale: Prevents runtime errors when accessing array indices or dictionary keys on empty response data, ensuring graceful handling of the prerequisite condition

robustness.description: The solution handles the case where the TEST project is not found in the workspace by providing a clear error message
robustness.rationale: Prevents cryptic failures during issue creation and provides actionable feedback if the project configuration is incorrect or missing

robustness.description: The solution includes timeout parameters for all HTTP requests to external services
robustness.rationale: Prevents the solution from hanging indefinitely if MailHog or Plane services are unresponsive, ensuring predictable execution time

robustness.description: The solution handles the case where the Plane API key is missing in the configuration file
robustness.rationale: Prevents authentication failures with unclear error messages and ensures the solution fails fast with actionable feedback if the API key is not present in the configuration

robustness.description: The solution handles the case where the Plane API key is malformed in the configuration file
robustness.rationale: Prevents authentication failures with unclear error messages and ensures the solution fails fast with actionable feedback if the API key format is invalid

robustness.description: The solution validates HTTP response status codes from MailHog API before processing response data
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution detects MailHog API failures early and avoids processing invalid or incomplete data that could lead to incorrect behavior

robustness.description: The solution validates HTTP response status codes from Plane API before processing response data
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution detects Plane API failures early and avoids processing invalid or incomplete data that could lead to incorrect behavior
